label: Geoapify
description: Geocode addresses, discover places, calculate routes and submit batch jobs

operations.name: geocode_address
operations.description: Find coordinates and address metadata from a free-text address.

operations.name: reverse_geocode
operations.description: Find an address at latitude and longitude.

operations.name: autocomplete_address
operations.description: Complete a partial address query.

operations.name: get_ip_location
operations.description: Locate an IP; omitting it locates NoClick's outbound server address.

operations.name: search_places
operations.description: Search place categories in a spatial filter; use offset for the next page.

operations.name: get_place_details
operations.description: Read details for a place ID returned by geocoding or places search.

operations.name: calculate_route
operations.description: Calculate directions; waypoints use latitude,longitude order.

operations.name: calculate_isoline
operations.description: Calculate time or distance reachability areas.

operations.name: calculate_route_matrix
operations.description: Calculate travel distances and times between sources and targets.

operations.name: get_elevations
operations.description: Get terrain elevations for ordered longitude,latitude locations.

operations.name: get_timezone
operations.description: Read timezone and UTC offset, optionally at an RFC3339 instant.

operations.name: search_postcodes
operations.description: Find a postcode and its boundary within a country.

operations.name: list_postcodes
operations.description: List postcodes matching text; request subsequent pages with offset.

operations.name: get_boundaries
operations.description: Find the administrative or postal boundaries containing coordinates.

operations.name: store_geometry
operations.description: Store a Point, LineString, Polygon, Feature or FeatureCollection.

operations.name: calculate_geometry
operations.description: Union or intersect two or more stored geometry or isoline IDs.

operations.name: submit_batch_geocode
